scope: Frequency discovery batches 8-15 and frozen v2 3-8 graph reservoir; discovery/ranking only.

diagnosis.verdict: BOTH DIMINISHING RETURNS AND SYSTEMATIC INTERNAL-NGRAM SURFACING
diagnosis.diminishingReturnsEvidence: The manual selections move increasingly into v2 ranks 4000-5000 and KEEP rate declines from 48-76% in batches 8-13 to 44% in batch 14 and 4% at the terminal tail in batch 15.
diagnosis.rankerPathologyEvidence: V2 retains every exact internal substring and sorts primarily by frequency. At the tail, common continuations, title/narrative seams, clipped covered parents, and incomplete question or reporting frames therefore outrank rarer complete lexical units.
diagnosis.batch15Finding: All 24 rejections are boundary, clipped-parent, productive/generic, or narrative-seam failures; only 拂子打圓相 survives as a complete observable action.
diagnosis.notPureCorpusExhaustion: Earlier diversified batches still found valid terms at high v2 ranks, and the v3 backtest improves KEEP concentration after boundary-aware reranking. The reservoir is not semantically empty, but sequential tail consumption is no longer efficient.

unsafeStaticFilters.conclusion: None may be used as a hard deletion rule; each has unacceptable known-KEEP loss. They are ranking penalties only.

v3Implementation.boundaryRule: Defer, never delete, when one immediate left or right graph occupies at least 95% of overlapping apparatus-clean CJK-run occurrences with support at least 12.
v3Implementation.expansionSafety: Only exact one-graph left/right forms are suggested. Suggestions remain discovery identities and require authority collision checks, exact zc recount, two work-distinct cases, and full semantic review before any selection or entry work.
v3Implementation.rankingSafety: Covered-family, generic-grammar, and reporting-frame signals are penalties, not exclusions. Frequency remains navigation only.

measuredBacktest.interpretation: Context deferral is high precision and collision-safe because it changes work order rather than semantic status. Reranking improves medium-depth yield but not top-25 yield, so it is a bottleneck aid rather than an admission classifier.

limitations: The 200-row backtest reflects adaptively selected batches, not a random sample of all 5000 v2 rows.
Immediate graph dominance detects highly stable boundary extensions but not every generic or narrative fragment; batch 15 still leaves 11 rejects in the ranked lane.
Three known KEEP terms are deliberately deferred, demonstrating why deferral must never mean rejection.

provenanceRebind.postAuditChangeScope: Added compact and terms-only output serialization CLI modes; no context, threshold, scoring, backtest, or mutation logic changed.
